story.note: Seraph eats no human food or O2

strings.reading: six PER STRING (one string per ring), not six for the ship: 12 rated is two strings at 1.0x
strings.finding: 12 people in one ring, or 12 on one string, needs 2.0x a string: above the 1.7x surge. Hardware is not doubled: a third (spare) string or per-ring surge to 2.0x is the question.

ledger.note: O2 recovery credited 0 and Garden credit 0 (life_support process rules); Sabatier vents methane, so water is lost with its hydrogen.

dehydrated + rehydration.note: rehydration ~0.8 kg water/person-day from the recovered loop (no makeup if recovery holds)

bulk staples + galley + 25 % garden calo.note: garden 120 m2 at the nominal 40 kW lighting load; seeds, nutrients and spares ~1-2 t

reserve.note: dense emergency rations 1.0 kg/person-day, kept in the refuge

preservation.degradation: Vitamins (C, B1, A) and texture decline over 3-5 years at room temperature (NASA Advanced Food Technology: many ISS foods fall below nutrition targets after ~3 years). A six-year store needs cold storage (~4 C) or frozen (-20 C) for the later half, supplements, and fresh garden produce for vitamins.

cold_store.note: refrigerated/frozen store for ~half the food; heat to the ring cold loops

preservation.storage: low temperature, low oxygen (nitrogen-flushed packs), dark; rotation first-in first-out

shield_water.dose_effect: GCR dose falls slowly with water areal density (~1-2 % per g/cm2 near 20-30 g/cm2): withdrawing 10 % of the ring water raises the habitat GCR dose by roughly 2-5 % (order of magnitude, needs a transport calculation).
rules: mandatory floor: the refuge 20 t never; ring water no lower than 90 % (PROTOTYPE) of its design areal density
draw symmetrically from paired compartments 180 deg apart, per ring, within the ring-balance tolerance (physics.ring_balance momentum 0.1 %)
shield water is non-potable until processed: biocide/additive chemistry and contamination checks, then the water processor
compartmentalised tanks with isolation valves; a leak isolates one cell, not the shield
shield_water.verdict: A controlled 10 % draw (16 t) covers the 98 %-recovery makeup plus the methane-vent loss (8.6 t, 5.4 %) with margin; at 90 % recovery (17.4 t) it is exceeded. Closing the Sabatier loop (methane pyrolysis / Bosch) removes the 6.4 t loss.

impulse.note: four flips (two per round trip, attitude.flips at Isp 300 s), 3 m/s of docking translation at departure and arrival mass, trim and CMG desaturation (STUDY)

cold gas N2.note: simple, inert, very heavy; tank pressure vessels

hydrazine monopropellant.note: flight-proven; toxic, freezes at 275 K, six-year storage heritage (Voyager)

gaseous H2/O2 (boil-off H2 + electrolysi.note: uses propellant and ECLSS the ship already carries; igniters; O2 competes with breathing

H2 resistojet / arcjet (boil-off H2).note: electric: ~F ve / 2 eta of power; good for trim and desaturation, too weak for flips

pcsc.note: Battery corrected to pack-level 2.5 t (the 800 Wh/kg figure is already a pack figure; Phase I applied packaging twice).

mass.note: Power mass kept apart from the Vertex drive-mass research; the drive_package (250 t) is unchanged here. Volume is not mass: the empty dry store is not unused mass allowance.
